title: Cube (bc30)
synopsis: Six different people, each from a different walk of life, awaken inside a giant cube with thousands of rooms. The identical rooms hold the threat of hideously inventive and painful death. Each gifted with a special skill, they must work together to escape an endless maze of deadly traps. Finding the real exit, however, may not offer the freedom one seeks. A micro-budget pioneer of the escape-room genre that grew into a cult sensation, the film was released at bc in 2002 to introduce local filmgoers to this overlooked gem.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 六個背景迥異的人――警察、數學天才、建築設計師、醫生、逃脫大師和殘疾人，醒來後發現自己身處一個巨大的立方體中，無人憶起自己如何被帶進去，亦無人知曉等待着他們的到底是什麽。各懷絕技的六人必須同心協力，穿梭於各個外觀完全相同、隨機佈滿致命陷阱的房間，共同查出被囚禁的真相，找到出口重見天日。導演以超低成本開創密室逃脫電影先河，掀起驚人迴響，晉身經典 Cult 片之列。bc 於 2002 年公映此片，讓影迷追回這部當年走漏眼之作。
